newsAll.body: Olave caught nine of 13 targets for 107 yards in Sunday's 35-27 loss to the Raiders.

newsAll.body: Ferguson (ankle) has returned to Sunday's game against the Broncos, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

newsAll.head: Parker Washington: Receiving TD in win
newsAll.body: Washington secured three of five targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 35-6 win over the Patriots on Sunday.

newsAll.head: Trevor Lawrence: Three TD tosses in Week 3 win
newsAll.body: Lawrence completed 19 of 29 passes for 182 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding four rushes for 25 yards in the Jaguars' 35-6 win over the Patriots on Sunday.
